Hi Sarah / HarborTech procurement team,

Welcome — excited to get HarborTech set up as a Redwood vendor. To complete vendor onboarding and get a PO in place, we need the items below. If you can attach them to this thread or upload to the shared Drive link, that will speed things up.

Required for vendor record and PO creation:
- Certificate of Insurance (COI): General Liability (min $1M), Professional E&O (min $2M), and Cyber/Privacy liability. Please include Redwood Inference as certificate holder and add the following endorsement text to the cyber certificate: "Redwood Inference, 1224 Market St, San Francisco, CA — Additional Insured".
- W-9 (completed, signed)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached link below) with remit-to and tax classification
- Point of contact for billing and invoicing, and preferred PO terms (Net 30 is our standard)

Optional but helpful:
- Any reseller or payment instructions for AP
- If HarborTech requires a different contract term, flag it now so we can route for approvals

Upload link: https://drive.google.com/harbortech_onboarding_form
Proc ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4521

Goal: once COI + W-9 + form are received, procurement will raise PO and accounts payable will confirm payment terms. Can you confirm an ETA for the attachments?

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Operations Manager
